framing: Everyone ships a fullscreen macOS bust app with halftone visemes — you ship a terminal-only Socratic CLI. The bust becomes ASCII; the abstention mechanic becomes a unicode glyph (⊘) printed to stdout; judges evaluate by piping demo input through stdin instead of clicking a hero CTA.
target_persona: Kaggle/DeepMind judges who triage 200+ submissions via SSH-into-evaluation-VM and prefer `cat demo.log` over watching a 2-minute screen recording — plus the dotfiles-tribe of Korean dev-edu users who already live in tmux.
primary_surface: terminal/CLI (`socrates --lang ko` REPL with stdin/stdout transcript; no GUI, no web preview, no Electron)
opus_4_7_capability: Native function calling routed through a TTY contract: `mode_classify` → `ask_back`/`defer_to_human` dispatched as named subprocess events printed inline; configurable thinking mode rendered as a single-line spinner; the 4-function dispatch becomes a CLI verb table.
mvp_scope: A 4-day buildable Swift CLI that wraps the existing SocraticEngine in `.stub` mode and renders one full Korean Socratic turn — push-to-talk replaced by readline, viseme PNGs replaced by ASCII frames, defer_to_human surfaced as `⊘ defer_to_human(reason=medical)` followed by the verbatim 평어체 response.
one_liner_pitch: Everyone ships a halftone-bust GUI; we ship `brew install hewassocrates` — a Korean Socratic REPL that fits in a tmux pane and refuses cloud egress by construction.
spec_alignment_notes: spec_alignment_notes: target_persona deliberately reframed away from the spec's primary 'Kaggle judges scrolling an HTML preview' anchor toward 'judges who SSH/cat logs' to honor the contrarian bias (unfashionable surface). primary_surface intentionally violates the spec's primary_artifact_A 'single-file HTML preview' assumption — that is the role of this advocate per the agent definition (primary_surface ≠ Web). All frozen invariants preserved verbatim: NO-CLOUD, defer_to_human load-bearing, 단정한 평어체 verbatim, no photoreal lip-sync (ASCII art is the contrarian-equivalent of 1-bit halftone). Metrics (192 ms TTFT, n=10 M1 Max) cited unchanged from bench/2026-05-06-latency-bench.json.
